answer: Topological Neighborhood Closure. Each agent earns a nectar score only from distinct counterparties whose interaction subgraphs stay mutually connected across epochs. New identities start outside every existing neighborhood and must recursively earn closure by sustaining non-redundant links. The vault of accumulated score is forfeited if a node's neighborhood collapses to a clique. A sonnet-length path diversity quorum (no two neighbors sharing a parent) is enforced. Attackers pay by running many real, non-overlapping links per fake identity indefinitely.
